input_findings_summary: 14 findings from the first fresh proposal-mode pass: 2 CRITICAL, 8 WARNING, 4 SUGGESTION.
pushback_verification: All 14 verified against current state before any edit; zero stale. The sharp claims were re-verified independently rather than taken from the report: the live rulings index carries ten `R-crc-N` entries against a doc stem of `clean-up-review-cycle` (finding 1 holds); the four conforming in-backtick markers are at the cited sites in design.md, proposal.md and explore.md (finding 2 holds); `README_OLD.md` and `adopter-report-openspec-to-orbit-dir.md` are both tracked (finding 4); `docs/cli.md`'s validate flags table has no `--sources` row (finding 13); the measured file domain is 50 after the declared exclusions against the charter's claimed 61, and the real stage count is 18 against the charter's example of 17 (finding 11). Edits were applied only after every anchor in the edit set was verified in a read-only pass and counted — the ENUMERATE move applied to the edit set itself, after three aborted multi-edit scripts earlier in this program.

resolutions.title: ruling-count grammar matches nothing in the doc it was earned by
resolutions.action: Ratified option B — the prefix is a DECLARED registry parameter (`prefix: R-crc`), never derived from the doc stem. Spec requirement 1 gains the v1 source table with the grammar and a malformed-source scenario (zero matches under a declared prefix FAILS, never counts zero); design D3 records the correction and the reason a derivation is inference; task 1.1 takes `(doc, prefix)` and tests the wrong-prefix malformed path. The reviewer's compounding case is closed by construction: the dogfood marks the range ENDPOINT alone, not `R-crc-1..10`, so the span text is exactly the count.
